content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if the [product_name] can serve as a modem for internet access only. Please provide guidance. Thank you.

Hello, I have not used it solely for internet, but it is possible to set up internet routing using the built-in VPN server. You will need a SIM card with a data plan from your provider. In addition to the [product_name], you’ll also need the appropriate antenna and cable. This setup is useful for mobile applications or where a fixed telephone line is unavailable. If you have access to a fixed telephone connection, routing through that tends to be simpler.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring whether the [product_name] can be utilized specifically as a modem for general internet access, beyond its usual industrial applications. There’s some uncertainty about the exact configuration, with partial confirmation that internet routing is feasible via the VPN server. Advice is shared regarding necessary hardware and connectivity, highlighting a need for clearer, simplified instructions for this purpose.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] to provide straightforward internet modem functionality, preferably with easy configuration over mobile networks when a fixed line isn’t available.
